Name: Fennekin Cat and Dog Skin for Adopt n' Skin and Alternative Textures
Author: TerraTerraCotta
Description:
[size=4][u][b]Description[/b][/u][/size]
Fennekin's a cute little pokemon. Wouldn't it make for a lovely pet? Well whether you prefer cat or dogs, you can use this Fennekin skin along with reskin mods such as Adopt N' Skin or More Animals to turn your Cat and/or Dog into a Fennekin!

[s][b]Content Patcher Version Now Available!
[/b]The creator of the code would like to remain anonymous, but they gave me access to the strings for the manifest and content needed to create a Content Patcher version of the mod! Please do let me know if it works (and if it's broken what I need to do to fix it. I am very code illiterate ;w;)
[/s]I'm too code-illiterate to update this, Consider the Content Patcher version depreciated

Instead you should opt for the tested and functioning [b]ALTERNATIVE TEXTURES [/b]version!

[u][b]CREDITS[/b][/u]
Skins were reformatted, tested, and put together by TerraTerraCotta.
[i](These Skins were tested using Adopt N' Skin)
